name: clickhouse-on-aws
description: One-click ClickHouse cluster (with ClickHouse Keeper) on Amazon EC2, via AWS CDK or a standalone CloudFormation template

scripts.synth-template: cdk synth --quiet --path-metadata false --version-reporting false ClickHouseCluster ClickHouseEks && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('templates',{recursive:true});for(const [s,f] of [['ClickHouseCluster','clickhouse-cluster'],['ClickHouseEks','clickhouse-eks']])fs.writeFileSync('templates/'+f+'.template.json',JSON.stringify(require('./cdk.out/'+s+'.template.json'),null,1)+'\n')"
